branches.fallbackBehavior: MetaOracleDeviationTimelock price() tries the selected oracle and immediately tries the other on revert. A price deviation over 0.5% permits a permissionless challenge, with a 57600-second delay before accepting the backup while still deviant; healing requires an 86400-second delay after reconvergence. Current state was primary=true, backup=false, challenged=false, healing=false. The fixed-par primary cannot observe a depeg itself; switching requires external callers and the one Chainlink backup. The composers check nonnegative answers, not updatedAt freshness; no protective heartbeat, sequencer check or guaranteed switch completion is established.
